headline: Ronaldo hits 985 career goals after Al Nassr hat-trick, 15 short of 1,000
facts: ESPN's tracker puts Ronaldo at 985 career goals in 1,343 games, needing 15 more to reach 1,000.
On Oct 29, 2026 he scored a hat-trick in Al Nassr's 5-3 win over Al Kholood, his 67th career hat-trick.
One goal on Oct 23 against Al Faisaly is disputed: Opta ruled an own goal, the Saudi league credited Ronaldo.
background: Ronaldo joined Al Nassr in January 2023 after leaving Manchester United and has won five Ballon d'Ors.
footage_terms: Ronaldo Al Nassr hat trick Al Kholood highlights
Ronaldo goals Saudi Pro League October 2026

headline: Messi ends Argentina career with a penalty vs Benin and 41 goals in 2026
facts: ESPN's tracker says Messi scored a penalty in Argentina's 3-0 friendly win over Benin on Oct 6, his 126th Argentina goal in what it calls his final senior international appearance (208th cap).
His brace against Atlanta on Oct 17 took him to 25 MLS goals, the league lead at that point.
As of Nov 7 the page lists 41 goals and 19 assists in 47 games in 2026.
background: Messi captained Argentina to the 2022 World Cup and joined Inter Miami in 2023 after leaving Paris Saint-Germain.
footage_terms: Messi Inter Miami Atlanta United brace

headline: Manchester United's eight-game winless league run is worst in Premier League history
facts: ESPN says United are 18th and have failed to win any of their past eight league games, their worst run in Premier League history.
Mauricio Pochettino takes charge for the first time at Liverpool.
Liverpool are fourth in the table but have won only one of five home league games.
background: United won 2-1 at Anfield last season, their first win there in almost a decade.
footage_terms: Pochettino Manchester United press conference Liverpool
Manchester United winless run Premier League
Liverpool vs Manchester United Anfield preview

headline: Liverpool failed to register a shot on target at Anfield vs Arsenal, a first in 442 league games
facts: Against Arsenal, Liverpool had no shot on target for the first time in 442 league matches at Anfield.
Liverpool have won 1, drawn 2 and lost 2 of five league games at Anfield this season, but have the best away record in the top flight (4 wins, 1 draw).
In calendar year 2026 they won only 5 of 15 league home games.
background: Under Jurgen Klopp Liverpool went 68 league games unbeaten at home between April 2017 and January 2021.
footage_terms: Iraola press conference Liverpool home form

headline: Upamecano is three games short of the Bundesliga unbeaten record
facts: Upamecano has 53 consecutive Bundesliga appearances without defeat, going back to the start of 2024/25.
The record is 56 by Jerome Boateng (Bayern, 2012-2014); Lukas Hradecky of Leverkusen is second with 54.
His last league defeat was a 4-2 loss at Hoffenheim on the final day of 2023/24.
background: Upamecano joined Bayern from RB Leipzig in 2021 and Boateng's record has stood since the 2012-2014 period.

headline: Bayern and Dortmund level on 21 points after nine matchdays in tightest title race in years
facts: Bayern and Dortmund both have 21 points; Bayern lead on goal difference and both are unbeaten.
Dortmund's 21 points are their best after nine games since 2013/14.
Bayern have beaten Union Berlin 7-0 and Leipzig 6-1, but have not matched last season's nine-win start.
background: Bayern won the Bundesliga last season; Dortmund finished with 73 points, their best since 2018/19.

headline: Como thrash Lens 9-1 in Champions League, a record away goal haul
facts: Como won 9-1 away at Lens, the most goals any team has scored on the road in Champions League history.
Tasos Douvikas scored a hat-trick, the first by a Como player in European competition; Nico Paz added two assists.
Fabregas warned his team not to buy into their own hype.
background: Como are managed by former Arsenal and Barcelona midfielder Cesc Fabregas and sit fourth in Serie A with 23 points.
footage_terms: Douvikas hat trick Como Champions League

headline: England end Spain's 43-match unbeaten run with 3-2 win in Madrid
facts: England won 3-2 at the Metropolitano in the Nations League, ending Spain's 43-game unbeaten run.
Spain trailed 3-0 before Oyarzabal and Nico Williams scored, both created by Lamine Yamal.
Spain finished second in the group behind England.
background: Spain had gone about three years without a competitive defeat and had beaten England 3-2 at Wembley in September.

headline: Kane leads the Bundesliga in assists and matches his best season total
facts: Kane made two assists in Bayern's 2-1 win at Mainz, setting up goals for Joshua Kimmich and Lennart Karl.
He has eight Bundesliga assists, the most in the league, matching his best-ever Bundesliga season total.
He has gone four games without a goal, which the column says has happened only once before at Bayern.
background: Kane joined Bayern from Tottenham in summer 2023 and was Bundesliga top scorer with 36 goals last season.

headline: Kane wins the 2026 Ballon d'Or, first Englishman in 25 years
facts: Kane won the Ballon d'Or in London, ahead of Mbappe and Yamal, the first English winner since Michael Owen in 2001.
He scored 73 goals for club and country last season (61 for Bayern, 12 for England).
The Ballon d'Or website briefly published articles naming other winners before the ceremony.
background: Kane is the fifth Englishman to win the award after Stanley Matthews, Bobby Charlton, Kevin Keegan and Owen.

headline: Kane misses a penalty on first outing as Ballon d'Or winner as Bayern draw 2-2 with Dortmund
facts: Kane missed a penalty in Der Klassiker at the Allianz Arena, his first match since winning the Ballon d'Or.
The match finished 2-2, with Fabio Silva snatching a point for Dortmund.
The column does not give the exact match date, only that it was at the weekend.
background: Bayern and Dortmund have been the Bundesliga's main rivals for over a decade and Der Klassiker is its biggest fixture.

headline: Twente beat Excelsior 9-0 as Orjasaeter makes five assists
facts: Twente won 9-0 away at Excelsior, the biggest win on the continent that weekend.
Wout Weghorst scored four goals.
Sondre Orjasaeter became the first player this century to register five assists in an Eredivisie game.
background: Wout Weghorst is a veteran Dutch striker who has played in the Premier League and Bundesliga before returning to the Eredivisie.

headline: Raya has seven clean sheets in ten games and has not conceded a saveable goal
facts: Raya has kept seven clean sheets in ten Premier League games and is the only keeper yet to concede a saveable goal, per Gradient Sports.
Emiliano Martinez has conceded three saveable goals, Alisson four and Donnarumma five.
He has caught 13 crosses, the most of any keeper, and is a three-time Golden Glove winner.
background: Raya has made 117 Premier League appearances for Arsenal, keeping clean sheets in nearly half of them.
footage_terms: Arsenal goalkeeper Raya best in Premier League

headline: Arsenal top the table five points clear, with only one defeat this season
facts: Sky says Arsenal have won every game this season except a 3-0 defeat at Brighton in September.
They are five points clear at the top and visit Newcastle on Saturday.
Newcastle have won one of their five home league games.
background: Arsenal are managed by Mikel Arteta and dropped Manchester City from top spot after City's recent defeats.

headline: Liverpool conceded a record 53 league goals last season; Iraola tries to fix defence
facts: Under Arne Slot Liverpool conceded 53 league goals in 2025-26, their most ever in a 38-game Premier League season.
Iraola replaced Slot in June and Liverpool have conceded from set pieces only twice so far this season.
Since Ronald Araujo moved into defence in September they have conceded only three league goals with 11 men on the pitch.
background: Liverpool won the league in 2024-25 but finished fifth last season, 24 points fewer.

headline: Bournemouth equal club record with eight straight wins in all competitions
facts: Bournemouth have won four league games in a row and eight in all competitions, equalling a club record.
Marco Rose has been in charge for 16 games.
They host Nottingham Forest on Saturday.
background: Bournemouth were previously managed by Andoni Iraola, who left for Liverpool in the summer.

headline: Yamal becomes the Champions League's all-time leading teenage scorer with 14 goals
facts: ESPN says Yamal scored his 14th Champions League goal, making him the competition's all-time leading teenage goalscorer.
Barcelona were involved in the same matchday round, beating Aston Villa according to ESPN's headline list.
Yamal finished third in the 2026 Ballon d'Or voting.
background: Yamal is a Barcelona academy graduate who won LaLiga last season and was named the 2026 Ballon d'Or Young Talent.
footage_terms: Yamal Champions League goal Aston Villa Barcelona
Lamine Yamal teenage record Champions League

headline: Mbappe named LaLiga Player of the Month for October with 11 goals in the league
facts: Mbappe won LaLiga Player of the Month for October, his second such award after January 2025.
He scored four goals in October: two in the 4-1 win over Sevilla and two in the 2-1 Clasico win over Barcelona.
He ended October with 11 goals and two assists in the league.
background: Mbappe joined Real Madrid in 2024 and finished second to Kane in the 2026 Ballon d'Or.
footage_terms: Mbappe Clasico goals Barcelona Real Madrid

headline: Real Madrid beat Barcelona 2-1 in Clasico as Mbappe is flagged offside seven times
facts: Mbappe scored both goals in Real Madrid's 2-1 win at Barcelona, ending the hosts' nine-win start to the league season.
He was flagged offside seven times by Barcelona's high line, the most by any player in a major European league in six years.
Camavinga's run from deep set up the winning goal; Barcelona stayed top, with Atletico two points behind.
background: Mourinho previously coached Real Madrid from 2010 to 2013 and was named LaLiga Manager of the Month for October.
footage_terms: Mbappe winning goal Clasico Camp Nou

headline: Barcelona score 39 goals in nine games, the best LaLiga start in 86 years
facts: Barcelona beat Real Betis 5-2 to make it nine wins from nine in LaLiga, with 39 goals scored.
Sky says that is the best scoring start to a LaLiga season by any team in 86 years.
Nine opening wins is the longest run to start a campaign in 58 years.
background: Hansi Flick's Barcelona won a second straight LaLiga title last season with 94 points.

headline: Lazio post best-ever Serie A start after beating Juventus 3-0 in Turin
facts: Lazio won 3-0 at Juventus, their best-ever start to a Serie A season.
Oliver Provstgaard scored in the game, only the second top-division goal of his career.
Lazio's six-match winning run later ended in a 1-1 draw at Napoli in early November, with Inter one point behind.
background: Lazio last won Serie A in 1999-2000, and Juventus are one of Italy's most decorated clubs.

headline: Monza striker Varela leads Serie A scorers as Juventus ask about a EUR 35m price
facts: Varela has 9 league goals and 1 assist, plus a brace in the Coppa Italia, for 11 goals in 11 games.
Goal says Monza signed him from Benfica for about EUR 2.5 million a few months ago and now want a guaranteed EUR 35 million.
Juventus, Napoli and Tottenham under De Zerbi are reported to be interested.
background: Varela is a 2005-born Portuguese forward who came through at Benfica, who hold a 20% sell-on clause.
footage_terms: Monza Avellino Coppa Italia Varela brace

headline: Haaland's 78th-minute winner at Leipzig is his 14th goal of the season
facts: Haaland scored the 78th-minute winner in City's 3-2 win at RB Leipzig, his 14th goal of the season.
It was his 13th goal against Leipzig in nine appearances, more than against any other opponent.
He had only 13 touches in the match and told City to step up.
background: Haaland scored five in City's 7-0 win over Leipzig in 2023.

headline: Haaland scores three for Norway in the break while City suffer three straight league defeats
facts: Haaland scored a penalty in Norway's 3-1 win over Wales and a late winner in a 3-2 comeback win over Denmark, sending Norway into the Nations League quarter-finals.
City have lost three straight Premier League games and host Fulham on Saturday.
Maresca named Haaland one of four club captains alongside Ruben Dias, Marc Guehi and Gianluigi Donnarumma.
background: Haaland, 26, is in his fifth season at City after joining from Borussia Dortmund in 2022.

headline: Donnarumma's goals-prevented number turns negative at Man City
facts: ESPN's goals-prevented figure for Donnarumma is -1.2 this season, after +6.8 for City last season.
Over his last six games he is at -4.0 goals prevented.
City had lost three of their last seven matches and allowed 12 goals in those seven; Maresca said the form is no concern.
background: Donnarumma moved from Paris Saint-Germain to Manchester City and has since been named one of City's four captains.

headline: PSG win ten in a row across all competitions after 6-0 thrashing of Villarreal
facts: PSG beat Villarreal 6-0, leading 4-0 after 17 minutes.
They have won all four Champions League games, outscoring opponents 20-5, with wins over Manchester City and Barcelona.
ESPN counts ten straight wins in all competitions by a combined 36-9; Real Madrid are the only other team with four wins from four.
background: PSG are two-time defending Champions League winners and were named Men's Club of the Year at the 2026 Ballon d'Or.

headline: Man United come from 2-0 down to beat Roma 3-2 and end a nine-match winless run
facts: United beat Roma 3-2 at Old Trafford on Nov 3 after trailing 2-0 inside 20 minutes, ending a nine-match winless run.
Bruno Fernandes scored a retaken penalty and Matheus Cunha scored twice.
During the run United scored 6 goals from 9.9 xG; Opta gave them a 9.5% chance of a top-seven finish.
background: Baleba, a EUR 75.9 million signing, has played only 397 minutes because of injuries, per ESPN.

headline: Bayern beat Atletico 2-0 for first clean sheet in eight games after a rare 0-0 at Schalke
facts: Bayern won 2-0 against Atletico Madrid, their first clean sheet in eight games; Konrad Laimer scored a long-range goal.
Atletico had won seven straight in LaLiga before the game.
Bayern's earlier 0-0 at Schalke was their first scoreless game in over a year.
background: Bayern are coached by Vincent Kompany and were knocked out of last season's Champions League semi-final by PSG.

headline: Club Brugge striker Tresoldi has five Champions League goals, including a hat-trick at Inter
facts: Club Brugge beat PSV 2-1 on matchday four with a Nicolo Tresoldi goal.
Tresoldi has five Champions League goals this season, including a hat-trick at Inter.
ESPN says Inter lost at home to Club Brugge and Brugge have three wins from four European games.
background: Brugge's 2-1 win over PSV came after they beat Inter at home in the league phase, per ESPN.
footage_terms: Tresoldi hat trick Inter Club Brugge
Inter Club Brugge Champions League highlights

headline: Yamal named best LaLiga player of 2025/26 after 16 goals and 12 assists
facts: LaLiga named Yamal Best Player of 2025/26 after 16 goals and 12 assists.
Barcelona won three of the five awards: Yamal, Hansi Flick (Best Coach, 94 points) and Joan Garcia (Best Save).
Levante's Carlos Espi, 20, won the U23 award with 11 goals, 10 in the last 13 matchdays; Arda Guler won Best Goal.
background: The awards will be presented on December 28 in the UAE at the Globe Soccer Awards.
footage_terms: Lamine Yamal LaLiga best player award

headline: Porto win all 11 matches to start the Primeira Liga season
facts: Sky's Euro Debrief says Porto have won all of their 11 matches this season.
The same column notes PSG's 11th straight win in all competitions, a 1-0 win over Troyes.
In Ligue 1, Lassine Sinayoko has nine league goals, two more than anyone else.
background: Porto are one of Portugal's big three clubs alongside Benfica and Sporting.

headline: Rennes teenager Thymeo Hanyurwimana Ferreira Cruz, 14, could become Ligue 1's youngest debutant
facts: Thymeo was born on 5 April 2012 and normally plays for Rennes' under-15s, with matches for the under-17s.
Rennes signed him to a semi-professional deal in October 2025 that takes effect on 1 July 2027.
Goal says that if he debuts then he would be Ligue 1's youngest ever, at 15 years and under three months; Barcelona and Manchester City are reported to be interested.
background: Rennes' academy has produced Ousmane Dembele, Eduardo Camavinga and Desire Doue.
